verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's docs describe scheduled tasks that run on a recurring cron schedule. Schedules can be declared in code and synced on dev/deploy, or created, activated, disabled, edited and deleted in the dashboard without redeploying. A hands-on community user independently reports the scheduled task feature is "super simple and just works exactly as expected." Missing for 10: deeper documented edges such as timezone handling and programmatic/per-user schedule creation via the SDK.
